title: Conditional Sentences (If-Clause)
subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: A Conditional Sentence expresses a condition and its possible result.
definition.marathi: ज्या वाक्यात एखादी अट (Condition) आणि तिचा परिणाम (Result) सांगितला जातो त्याला Conditional Sentence म्हणतात.

examples.word: If you study hard, you will pass.

partsExample.sentence: If you work hard, you will succeed.

types.name: Zero Conditional
examples: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
If you touch fire, it burns.
If ice melts, it becomes water.

types.name: First Conditional
use: Future result of a Present condition
examples: If you study hard, you will pass.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If you work honestly, you will succeed.

types.name: Second Conditional
examples: If I were rich, I would help the poor.
If I were a bird, I would fly.
If he had money, he would buy a car.

types.name: Third Conditional
examples: If he had studied, he would have passed.
If I had reached early, I would have met him.
If they had informed us, we would have attended.

rules.title: Zero Conditional
rules.english: Use Simple Present in both the If-Clause and the Main Clause to state facts and general truths.
rules.marathi: Facts आणि General Truths साठी If-Clause आणि Main Clause दोन्हीमध्ये Simple Present वापरा.
examples: If water boils, it evaporates.

rules.title: First Conditional
rules.english: Use If + Simple Present in the condition and Will + V1 in the result for a real future possibility.
rules.marathi: खऱ्या Future Possibility साठी Condition मध्ये If + Simple Present आणि Result मध्ये Will + V1 वापरा.
examples: If you work hard, you will succeed.

wrongRight.wrong: If you will work hard, you will succeed.
wrongRight.right: If you work hard, you will succeed.

rules.title: Never Use Will in If-Clause
rules.english: Will should never be used in the If-Clause of a First Conditional sentence.
rules.marathi: First Conditional च्या If-Clause मध्ये Will कधीही वापरू नये.
examples: If he comes, I will help.

wrongRight.wrong: If he will come, I will help.
wrongRight.right: If he comes, I will help.

rules.title: Second Conditional
rules.english: Use If + Simple Past in the condition and Would + V1 in the result for imaginary present/future situations.
rules.marathi: Imaginary Present/Future साठी Condition मध्ये If + Simple Past आणि Result मध्ये Would + V1 वापरा.
examples: If I had money, I would buy a car.

rules.title: Were With Every Subject
rules.english: Use were instead of was with every subject in imaginary/hypothetical situations.
rules.marathi: Imaginary Situations मध्ये प्रत्येक Subject सोबत was ऐवजी were वापरा.
examples: If I were you...
If he were rich...

wrongRight.wrong: If I was you, I would accept.
wrongRight.right: If I were you, I would accept.

rules.title: Third Conditional
rules.english: Use Had + V3 in the condition and Would have + V3 in the result to express past regret or impossible past.
rules.marathi: Past Regret साठी Condition मध्ये Had + V3 आणि Result मध्ये Would have + V3 वापरा.
examples: If he had studied, he would have passed.

wrongRight.wrong: If he had studied, he would pass.
wrongRight.right: If he had studied, he would have passed.

rules.title: Never Use Would in If-Clause
rules.english: Would should never be used in the If-Clause of a conditional sentence.
rules.marathi: If-Clause मध्ये Would कधीही वापरू नये.
examples: If he came, I would help.

wrongRight.wrong: If he would come, I would help.
wrongRight.right: If he came, I would help.

rules.title: Had + V3 Rule
rules.english: Always use the V3 (past participle) form after Had, never the past tense form.
rules.marathi: Had नंतर नेहमी V3 (Past Participle) फॉर्म वापरा, Past Tense फॉर्म वापरू नये.
examples: Had gone
Had taken
Had studied

rules.title: Mixed Conditional
rules.english: A past condition (Had + V3) can combine with a present result (Would + V1) in Mixed Conditionals.
rules.marathi: Mixed Conditional मध्ये Past Condition (Had + V3) आणि Present Result (Would + V1) एकत्र येतात.
examples: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.

rules.title: Inversion (Without If)
rules.english: If can be omitted by inverting the subject and auxiliary: Should + Subject + V1 (Type 1), Were + Subject (Type 2), Had + Subject + V3 (Type 3).
rules.marathi: If वगळून Subject आणि Auxiliary उलट क्रमाने वापरता येते: Should + Subject + V1 (Type 1), Were + Subject (Type 2), Had + Subject + V3 (Type 3).
examples: Should you need help, call me.
Were I rich, I would travel.
Had he worked hard, he would have passed.

rules.title: Can / Could
rules.english: Second Conditional can use Would/Could + V1; Third Conditional can use Would/Could have + V3.
rules.marathi: Second Conditional मध्ये Would/Could + V1 आणि Third Conditional मध्ये Would/Could have + V3 वापरता येते.
examples: If I had time, I could help you.
If he had tried, he could have won.

rules.title: Modals Instead of Will
rules.english: Can, may, might, could, should, must may replace will in the main clause depending on the intended meaning.
rules.marathi: अर्थानुसार Main Clause मध्ये Will ऐवजी Can, may, might, could, should, must वापरता येते.
examples: If you finish work, you may leave.
If it rains, we should stay home.

examStrategy.english: Learn all 4 Types thoroughly, memorize the formulas, focus on Error Spotting, and practice Sentence Improvement.
examStrategy.marathi: सर्व 4 Types पूर्णपणे शिका, Formulas पाठ करा, Error Spotting वर लक्ष द्या आणि Sentence Improvement चा सराव करा.

examStrategy.english: Master Mixed Conditionals, practice Inversion (Had/Were/Should), and solve Previous Year Questions.
examStrategy.marathi: Mixed Conditionals मध्ये प्रवीण व्हा, Inversion (Had/Were/Should) चा सराव करा आणि Previous Year Questions सोडवा.

practice.english: Solve 70-100 Conditional Sentence PYQs. Before the exam, revise only the Golden Revision Page.
practice.marathi: 70-100 Conditional Sentence PYQs सोडवा. परीक्षेपूर्वी फक्त Golden Revision Page Revise करा.

goldenRevision: Type 3 -> Had + V3 -> Would have + V3
